_meta.note: Cohort-fallback INTEGRITY & SAFETY (round 3) — the incentive, gaming, security, degradation-time-safety and regulatory safeguards that close the adversarial and clinical-safety gaps in the round-1/2 model. Four locked decisions (below) are guard-enforced. Builds on progressive-data.html + cohort-governance.html. Illustrative; re-verify (README §5.6).

decisions.v: For any marker that feeds a red/amber pathway, cohort-fill can NEVER raise the displayed score above the user's last real measurement (pessimistic prior for high-stakes reservoirs); a 'score-lift-from-imputation' monitor neutralises sustained positive lift. Withholding data can never flatter the score.

Actuarial/insurance scoring requires attested-source data (HealthKit/Health Connect signed + device attestation) over continuous real-data windows with a minimum real-fraction; strategic pre-pull gaps widen the risk band conservatively (never narrow/flatter); manual/unattested data is a capped lower-trust class; identity-continuity checks apply.

decisions.k: Care — referral fires but flags provenance
decisions.v: An automated PURA referral/escalation MAY fire on a cohort-influenced score, but the real-vs-cohort provenance of the triggering signal is attached and persisted for the receiving clinician as the basis-of-decision.

Real critical readings always break any freeze/floor; estimate-vs-measurement labelling is tied to provenance with a SaMD intended-use boundary; a contest/correction path feeds the ledger; a bounded degraded-state timeout drops to 'monitoring unavailable — seek care'; degrade/recovery transitions are actively notified.

rows.v: DECISION — for high-stakes (red/amber) reservoirs a cohort fill can only ever WIDEN the band or hold the worse value; it can never raise the displayed score above the last real measurement, so an unhealthy user can't gain by withholding.
Per user, track the displayed-score lift attributable to imputation; sustained positive lift is neutralised and flagged — measuring is always weakly better than withholding.

Measure score exploitability (sensitivity of the displayed score to disclosure choices), minimise it, and stratify score-lift-from-strategy by health-literacy/sophistication proxies so gaming doesn't become a new inequity.

Accuracy is weighted by the clinical importance of each reservoir (not raw fill count), and a separate, non-gameable 'clinically-critical coverage' indicator is shown, so users/clinicians can't pad the number with cheap low-value fields.

Platform attestation (HealthKit/Health Connect signed provenance, Play Integrity / hardware-backed keys), per-sample signing and replay nonces; high-value / actuarial decisions are bound to attested-source data; manual entries are a distinct lower-trust provenance class with capped influence.

Detect physiologically-impossible cross-session jumps (resting-HR/HRV/gait/cadence signature) consistent with a different person → flag for re-verification; periodic liveness-bound capture for actuarial use — stops proxy measurement and cross-person cohort contamination.

DECISION — actuarial scoring uses a continuous attested real-data look-back with a minimum real-fraction & recency; a heavily cohort-filled snapshot WIDENS the risk band conservatively (never narrows); strategic pre-pull silence is treated as an adverse signal, not neutral.

Robust aggregation (trimmed / median-of-means with influence-function caps so no account or account-cluster can move a cell beyond a bound), per-account contribution limits, and cross-account anomaly detection (shared device fingerprints, signup/IP clustering) against coordinated cell-shift attacks.

Rate-limit & log systematic probing; expose ranges / score-impact rather than raw substituted reservoir values; apply differential-privacy bounds to any cohort-derived output — so the engine can't be queried to reconstruct thin-cell medians.

Cohort aggregation consumes ONLY real + finalized + attested rows; imputed / provisional / cohort-filled / population-floor values are excluded. A collapse monitor compares successive cohort versions for variance-shrinkage / drift toward prior-cycle imputations and halts the rebuild if a cell's real-data fraction drops below threshold — no model autophagy.

DECISION — any input flagged real + device-validated that breaches a hard critical threshold (e.g. SpO₂ 70, BP 220/120, HR 30) bypasses ALL suppression (freeze, provisional, floor, hysteresis, k-anon) and fires the critical alert + care-pathway escalation immediately. Suppression can only ever delay/soften NON-critical signals.

A brand-new user with no data is treated exactly like the population-estimate-only floor from day 1 (labelled 'not yet personalized', trend/alerts frozen, mandatory first-session explainer); first-session alerting relies on ABSOLUTE critical thresholds only (no relative/trend) and prioritises collecting a real personal baseline before any reassuring framing.

DECISION — a degraded/frozen state cannot persist indefinitely; on expiry the score drops to an explicit 'monitoring unavailable — not assessed' state (not a number), reassuring framing is suppressed, and a seek-care-if-symptomatic safety net fires.

Every suppression mechanism (freeze, provisional, floor, hysteresis, cohort) is enumerated in a failure-mode analysis with its miss / false-negative modes, severity, and compensating control — each suppression must have the real-critical override and the bounded timeout as backstops.

DECISION — every transition into a degraded/estimate/frozen state fires an explicit user notification ('your score is now an estimate — reconnect to personalise'), with a matching recovery notification; both are logged to the ledger.

DECISION — an automated PURA referral/escalation may fire on a cohort-influenced score; the per-input real-vs-cohort provenance of the triggering signal is attached and persisted so the receiving clinician weighs it.

At every pathway decision (referral / escalation / enrolment) the real-vs-cohort composition of the triggering score is displayed and persisted as the immutable basis-of-decision the clinician attests to.

DECISION — a documented Software-as-a-Medical-Device classification + intended-use boundary (degraded scores may NOT drive specified clinical decisions); a machine-readable provenance/confidence state on every clinical output; an explicit 'estimate, not a measurement' label whenever any driving input is cohort/imputed.

DECISION — each cohort-filled input is disputable; a clinician override or patient-supplied correction recomputes the score; the dispute, corrector identity and resolution are written to the provenance ledger as first-class events.

Bare percentages are replaced with plain-language, validated confidence categories ('we're not yet confident — this is based mostly on people like you, not on you'), comprehension-tested with the target population and localised for Arabic/English literacy levels — so an estimate isn't read as a diagnosis or as reassurance.
